head.description: base of neck / skull attachment point

notes: All visible neutral artwork is direct pixel extraction from source.png.
The hood, cloak, necklace and pendant remain static in body.png. The skull and exposed neck bones move together in head.png.

No secondary spring layer is included because the pendant contains partially transparent source pixels; separating it would require inventing or altering visible source artwork to avoid a hole beneath it.
Hidden reconstruction is limited to a narrow dark hood-interior band behind the head.
This skeleton has no eyelids. eyes_closed.png performs a source-aligned glow-off blink inside the detected green socket regions.
